operator_window_reason: fixed pre-score component-validity window; outside it, extrapolated baryonic subtraction can become nonphysical although no scored pressure point requires that region
sample_rule: eligible complete-component X-COP clusters sorted by SHA256('XCOP-HSE-v1:'+name); first 4 development, remaining 3 heldout
score: diagonal X-COP X-ray electron-pressure chi2 after analytically profiling exactly one additive pressure-boundary nuisance per arm
safe_policy: minimum development macro mean chi2/point including f=0
forced_nonzero_diagnostic: minimum development macro mean chi2/point with f>0
baseline_recovery: f=0 exact mass and pressure-prediction identity
mass_conservation: normalized convolution plus finite-grid leakage receipt; stop if absolute raw leakage exceeds 0.05; deterministic finite-grid renormalization recorded

gold_or_score_visibility.heldout: public source files physically accessible; no heldout scoring before policy freeze by executed path
gold_or_score_visibility.claim: procedural untouched-cluster holdout, not cryptographically hidden

claim_boundary: public profile direct-equation diagnostic only; not raw observational-likelihood proof, unique-kernel evidence, Einstein-level proof, or physical-law validation
stop_conditions: raw finite-grid mass leakage above threshold
